QK_elt_P (layer 53) has 66.2% memory and 33.6% communication. All four layers have significant DRAM time (dram_time close to latency_sum) and NoC time (noc_time). The DRAM BW is 64 GB/s and NoP BW is 128 GB/s. Increasing NoP BW from 128 to 256 GB/s would directly reduce the communication time (33-54% of these layers), and increasing DRAM BW from 64 to 128 GB/s would reduce memory time (53-66%). The monetary cost of IO is only 12.3% ($29.19), so doubling bandwidth would increase IO cost but likely by less than 2x (since cost scales sub-linearly). The compute cost (49.8%) and OS cost (37.9%) would remain unchanged. I should propose increasing NoP BW to 256 GB/s as the primary move, since communication is the dominant root cause for res1 (54.4%) and significant for res2 (46.0%) and norm2 (33.4%). This targets the critical path directly.
